title: [AUG-210] Implement the "Name this meeting" pop-up with a model-suggested name and click-to-edit title on the session page
why_we_need_this:
Sessions stay under their auto title because renaming is hidden in the sidebar (double-click) or tied to Praxis export, which makes the sidebar, Archive and Praxis exports hard to scan. AUG-209 research (approved by the user on 2026-11-16) chose: a corner pop-up on the timer page that asks for a name while the recording transcribes, a name suggested by the language model the user already enabled, automatic use of that suggestion when the user does not answer, and click-to-edit on the session page title. AUG-209 also found a real race in which a rename can be overwritten by the transcription pipeline; it must be closed here.

Research: @docs/mockups/AUG-209/findings.md · Mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-209/naming.html (sections P1 and S1 are the chosen ones).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] While a session is `preparing` or `transcribing`, a corner pop-up "Name this meeting" is shown on the timer page as in mockup P1: input with the auto title as placeholder, Save (green), Later (outline), close ✕; it does not cover the ring and never takes keyboard focus on its own
- [ ] Save sends PATCH /api/sessions/:id; the header title and the sidebar show the new name immediately, without reload; the pop-up closes
- [ ] Later / ✕ hides the pop-up for that session; the timer keeps running and Cancel keeps working the whole time
- [ ] When a text model is enabled (local language model downloaded and on, or Groq online text with a valid consent; both on → `batchCorrectionEngine`), the server produces a suggested title after whisper and stores it as `suggestedTitle`; the pop-up shows it as a yellow chip "SUGGESTED · <name>" and a click puts it into the input
- [ ] With no text model enabled the pop-up shows no suggestion row and nothing is renamed automatically
- [ ] When transcription completes and the user has not named the session (`titleSource` is `auto`) and a suggestion exists, the title becomes the suggestion and `titleSource` becomes `model`; a name set by the user (`titleSource: user`) is never replaced; sessions created before this change (no `titleSource`) are never renamed
- [ ] A suggestion that fails, times out (20 s) or is not one line of 3–80 characters is dropped silently: the session still completes with its auto title, nothing is shown to the user
- [ ] A rename sent at any moment of transcription, including the last stages, is still the title after the session is `completed` (per-session write queue in `updateSession`)
- [ ] On the session page the header title is click-to-edit as in mockup S1: hover shows a dashed underline and a yellow pencil; Enter or blur saves; Esc restores the previous title and does not close an open overlay; empty or unchanged input sends no request
- [ ] Title input is limited to 120 characters; the server trims, collapses line breaks and repeated spaces, and cuts to 120
- [ ] A failed save keeps the typed text and shows "Could not save the name. Try again." in red
- [ ] The title cannot be edited while the session is `uploading` (the server may still replace it for link sessions)
- [ ] New single-track and recovered recordings get the default title `Recording <date time>` instead of the file name; uploaded files keep their file name
- [ ] Sidebar double-click rename and the Praxis export rename keep working and set `titleSource: user`
- [ ] Styling follows the brandbook: 0 border-radius, green = primary, yellow = suggestion / hover pencil, outline = normal, red = error only; no technical details in the UI
- [ ] Ctrl/Cmd+1..4 and Electron global shortcuts work while the pop-up is visible and while a title input is focused
- [ ] Works the same on Windows and macOS (no platform branch); client type check, server type check and build pass
important_constraints:
- Order: 2/2. Depends on: AUG-209-qlb9yg (research, approved 2026-11-16).
- Reuse PATCH /api/sessions/:id; no new endpoint.
- Files to touch:
  - @client/src/components/TranscriptView.tsx — pop-up inside the status panel (statuses preparing / transcribing), click-to-edit `.transcript-circuit-title` (line 589), uses the existing `onRename` prop
  - @client/src/App.css — pop-up and title-edit styles
  - @client/src/App.tsx — `handleRename` (line 241): keep a pending rename over the 5 s poll result until the PATCH resolves
  - @client/src/types.ts and @server/src/types.ts — `titleSource?: 'auto' | 'user' | 'model'`, `suggestedTitle?: string`
  - @server/src/services/sessionManager.ts — per-session in-process write queue inside `updateSession` (line 119); default title and `titleSource: 'auto'` in `createSession` (line 77)
  - @server/src/routes/sessions.ts — PATCH (line 647): normalise, cap, `titleSource: 'user'`; completion writes (lines 155, 237) apply the suggestion; link flows (lines 881, 995) keep `auto`
  - @server/src/services/semanticCheck.ts — title suggestion step in the post-whisper pass
- Suggestion input: first ~2,000 characters of the merged transcript plus action item texts. Local model call stays inside the existing whisper batch slot; Groq call goes through the shared text limiter and only under the existing online-text consent.
- The race fix is an in-process queue. Do not switch session.json to tmp-file + rename without a retry: on Windows the rename can fail with EPERM while another process holds the file.
- The suggestion must never delay `completed` by more than its 20 s cap and must never fail a session.
- Do not add the title or any naming control to Compact mode, the Dock Strip or the tray.
- No Electron changes are needed; the completion notification already shows the current title.
- No tests unless explicitly requested.
